steps.title: Hear Mavuin's plea in his cell

requires.why: information only sets mavuin=1 when mavuinFlag == 0, and only answers at all when mavuinFlag <= 1

actions.detail: Hail Mavuin in his prison cell; with no mavuin flag he offers his journal and mentions [information].
Say information to receive the flag.

steps.credit: Only the player who says information (e.other); set_global with no group loop.
steps.message: Mavuin tells you, 'I know it has been said for years before me, and will be said for years after me, but I was truly framed for my crime. ... Please go before the tribunal and plead my case. ...' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: The information keyword is ignored once mavuin >= 2 (condition mavuinFlag <= 1).
If you already have mavuin=1 the text and 'You have received a character flag!' repeat but the value is not changed.
Hail with mavuin=1 answers 'Please it is the only hope that I live for...' - that means you already have stage 1; go to the Tribunal.
steps.notes: findi is a substring match, so any sentence containing 'information' works. #popflags shows stage 1 as 'The evidence needed to save Mavuin has been requested'. Seer guided meditation: 'The evidence of Mavuin is the only thing that can save him now.'

steps.title: Win a Tribunal trial and loot its Mark

actions.detail: Optional flavor: the Tribunal asks if you are prepared.
Optional: the Tribunal you speak to describes its trial (each of the six trial-room Tribunals runs a different trial).

actions.say: ready to begin the Trial of Lashing
actions.detail: Say this exact phrase to the Lashing Tribunal (or 'ready to begin the Trial of Execution' / Stoning / Torture / Hanging / Flame to the matching Tribunal) to start and be teleported in.

Win the trial; the trial boss spawns at the end (Lashing #Lashman_Azakal, Execution #Prime_Executioner_Vathoch, Stoning #Yurae_Zhaleem, Torture #Punisher_Veshtaq, Hanging #Gallows_Master_Teion, Flame #Punisher_of_Flame).
Each boss drops its own Mark (100% chance, multiplier 6 per DB loot table); every player must loot one for themselves.

steps.credit: No flag. Marks are loot (lore, no-drop) from the trial boss corpse; each player loots their own.
steps.message: The Tribunal says 'Then begin.' and you are teleported into the trial.
debug: The start phrase must contain 'ready to begin the ' plus that Tribunal's own trial name; saying another trial's name to the wrong Tribunal does nothing.
'That trial is already underway.  You must wait.' means the trial is locked (trialsUnderway) or a non-GM client or non-pet NPC is still inside its boundary box.
Lockout after success is 10 minutes (players warned at 9 min with 'The Tribunal will summon you from the trial in one minute.' and returned at ~10 min); after failure it is 1 minute.
Only your group members within 50 units of the speaker are teleported in; in a raid, only the speaker's raid group within 50 units; ungrouped = just you.

On failure you see '<Trial name> has failed.  The Tribunal's judgment has been rendered.  You will be returned from the trial shortly.' and are returned 10 s later; player corpses in the trial are moved to the graveyard.
The boss corpse decay timer is set to 8 minutes (SetDecayTimer 480000), and the success boot happens at ~10 minutes: loot your Mark promptly.
Marks are lore: you cannot loot a second copy of a Mark you already hold.
steps.notes: Each Mark is lore and no-drop (items table). Failure conditions are per trial (e.g. a prisoner dying: 'You have failed.' emotes). Logging in inside a trial area moves you to 473,685,10 (pojustice/player.lua).

steps.title: Plead Mavuin's case to the Tribunal

requires.why: Tribunal only sets 2 when mavuin == '1' and FindMarks > 0

npcs.name: The_Tribunal
npcs.notes: any of the six npc 201508 trial-room Tribunals answers 'mavuin'

steps.message: The Tribunal tells you, 'You have completed a trial - impressive for mortals.  You can tell Mavuin that we will hear his plea.  We will seek him out as time befits us.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: With no mavuin flag at all the Tribunal says nothing to 'mavuin' (if qglobals.mavuin).
mavuin=1 but no Mark: 'So, mortal, you wish us to allow a prisioner to plead his case? ... You must prove yourself in one of our trials before we will consider hearing this plea.'
Marks are found by Client:HasItem: worn/inventory slots 0-30, cursor queue, bags 250-339, bank 2000-2007 and bank bags 2030-2109, shared bank 2531-2550. Marks left on a corpse do not count.
Hail only gives the emote 'What do you want, mortal?' - you must say mavuin.
With mavuin=3 the reply is 'Do not worry about Mavuin...' (already done).
steps.notes: #popflags stage 2: 'The Tribunal has agreed to hear Mavuin's case'. The Seventh Hammer room Tribunals (npc 201427) share the same script file but are not normally reachable.

steps.title: Tell Mavuin the Tribunal will hear him

actions.detail: Return to Mavuin's cell and hail him.

steps.message: Mavuin tells you, 'So you have pleaded my case to the Tribunal, I am most thankful. ... seek an audience with Karana and Mithaniel Marr. ... Also seek from Marr a way to translate the divine language. ...' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Hail with mavuin=1 gives 'Please it is the only hope that I live for...' - you still need the Tribunal step.
The flag line prints on every hail at mavuin >= 2, so seeing it again does not mean a new flag.
steps.notes: mavuin=3 opens the Plane of Valor and Plane of Storms portals in PoTranquility (door 16 / 21 set zone flags 210 and 208). #popflags stage 3: 'Mavuin's case is complete'. cl_aerindar (tier 2) later requires mavuin=3.

steps.title: Show all six Marks to the Tribunal

requires.value: all 6 trial Marks held (or seventh already set)

actions.detail: Holding all six Marks, say knowledge to a trial-room Tribunal; you receive the flag and The Mark of Justice.

steps.message: The Tribunal tells you, 'Most impressive.  It has been long since a mortal has shown such prowess.'  It considers you for a long moment.  'There is one final test that you must undergo.'  A gleaming metal disc appears in your hand.  'Hold up the Mark of Justice as you enter the portal, and prepare for your judgement.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: 1-5 Marks: 'You have done well, mortal, but there are more trials yet for you to complete.'
0 Marks: 'The knowledge of the gods is not so easily given to an unproven mortal.'
Once seventh is set, saying knowledge again re-summons The Mark of Justice if you no longer have it (HasItem check).
Marks count from inventory, bags, bank and shared bank (Client:HasItem).
steps.notes: The Seer header says the keyword is 'information', but the script matches 'knowledge'. The seventh flag is not checked by any script: the Seventh Hammer port is gated by the Mark of Justice item only. Not required for tier-1 completion in #popflags (which shows 'Seventh Hammer access: Unlocked/Locked').

debug: The Mark must be on the cursor, not in a bag or equipped (GetItemIDAt(0)).
If the Seventh Hammer is up and engaged, the move is cancelled (IsEngaged check) and you take the normal door destination.
Only door ids 1-6 trigger the move.

If you dare travel into this pungent plane and find the ward bring it back.  If we can halt the advancing toxins in Milyk's system maybe we can save him.' then 'You have received a character flag!'

Hail the projection within 20 minutes.

npcs.notes: npc 205156, eq.spawn2 at Grummus' death location; depops after 20 minutes

steps.credit: Clients in the same raid (by raid id) as the player with kill rights; if that player is not in a raid, their group; if ungrouped, only that player. Code: rid/gid/cid captured from eq.signal(PLANAR_PROJECTION_TYPE, e.killer:GetID()).

This etheric energy is the only thing that can stop this plague that has been placed upon me.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: No reply at all means you are not in the credited raid/group (ClientCanFlag) or the projection has hit its counter limit (flags <= 144).

The projection depops 20 minutes after spawning.
This also deletes any cl_grummus you held, and sets grummus=1 if you did not have it (same hail).

Each hail can add up to 2 to the counter (fuirstel + grummus). #popflags labels stage 2 'The Ward was recovered'.
